detail: Customer count is not tracked in the database
The data for product discontinuation is NOT TRACKED

sql:
SELECT Country, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS CustomerCount 
FROM sales.Customers 
GROUP BY Country

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2023

SELECT DATEPART(month, OrderDate) AS Month, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount 
FROM sales.Orders 
WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2025 
GROUP BY DATEPART(month, OrderDate) 
ORDER BY Month

SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrderCount
FROM sales.Orders
WHERE OrderDate >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()) - 1, 0)
  AND OrderDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS NewCustomersCount 
FROM sales.Customers 
WHERE YEAR(CreatedAt) = 2025

SELECT SUM(LineTotal) AS TotalRevenue 
FROM sales.OrderLines 
WHERE OrderId IN (SELECT OrderId FROM sales.Orders WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2025 AND Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned'))

SELECT YEAR(o.OrderDate) AS Year, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS Revenue 
FROM sales.Orders o 
JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId 
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') 
GROUP BY YEAR(o.OrderDate) 
ORDER BY Year ASC

SELECT c.CustomerId, c.CompanyName, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(ol.LineTotal) AS Revenue
FROM sales.Orders o
JOIN sales.OrderLines ol ON ol.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025 AND o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.CompanyName, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY Revenue DESC, c.CustomerId

SELECT c.Segment, AVG(t.OrderRevenue) AS AverageOrderValue
FROM (
    SELECT o.CustomerId, SUM(l.LineTotal) AS OrderRevenue
    FROM sales.Orders o
    JOIN sales.OrderLines l ON l.OrderId = o.OrderId
    WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    GROUP BY o.CustomerId
) AS t
JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = t.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.Segment

SELECT TOP (5) p.Name, SUM(ol.Quantity) AS UnitsSold 
FROM sales.OrderLines ol 
JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = ol.ProductId 
JOIN sales.Orders o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId 
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') 
AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2025 
GROUP BY p.Name 
ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC

SELECT ed.FirstName, ed.LastName, COUNT(o.OrderId) AS OrderCount 
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory ed 
JOIN sales.Orders o ON ed.EmployeeId = o.SalesRepId 
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' 
GROUP BY ed.EmployeeId, ed.FirstName, ed.LastName 
ORDER BY OrderCount DESC

SELECT TOP 1 s.SupplierId, s.Name, COUNT(p.ProductId) AS ProductCount 
FROM catalog.Suppliers s 
JOIN catalog.Products p ON s.SupplierId = p.SupplierId 
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 0 
GROUP BY s.SupplierId, s.Name 
ORDER BY ProductCount DESC

detail: The data for cancelled orders is not tracked

sql:
SELECT d.Name, COUNT(ed.EmployeeId) AS CurrentEmployeesCount
FROM hr.Departments d
LEFT JOIN hr.EmployeeDirectory ed ON d.DepartmentId = ed.DepartmentId AND ed.TerminationDate IS NULL
GROUP BY d.Name

SELECT ed.FirstName, ed.LastName
FROM hr.EmployeeDirectory ed
JOIN hr.Departments d ON ed.DepartmentId = d.DepartmentId
WHERE d.Name = 'Sales' AND ed.ManagerId IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.Name AS CategoryName, SUM(lo.LineTotal) AS Revenue 
FROM catalog.Categories c 
JOIN sales.Orders o ON o.CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM sales.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2026-01-01') 
JOIN sales.OrderLines lo ON lo.OrderId = o.OrderId 
WHERE o.Status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned') 
AND c.CategoryId = c.CategoryId 
GROUP BY c.Name

sql:
SELECT WarehouseId, COUNT(ProductId) AS ProductsBelowReorderLevel
FROM inventory.Stock
WHERE QuantityOnHand < ReorderLevel
GROUP BY WarehouseId

SELECT w.Name AS WarehouseName, p.Name AS ProductName, p.UnitCost * s.QuantityOnHand AS TotalValue 
FROM inventory.Stock s 
JOIN inventory.Warehouses w ON s.WarehouseId = w.WarehouseId 
JOIN catalog.Products p ON s.ProductId = p.ProductId 
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 0

FROM sales.Orders o 
LEFT JOIN sales.Payments p ON o.OrderId = p.OrderId 
WHERE p.OrderId IS NULL AND o.Status = 'Delivered'

FROM sales.Customers
